name: zenbot-stock-scanner
description: Real-time US stock scanner: scan the market for setups in plain words, see what is on your ZenBot scans and why, read charts, and build and save scans.

interface.longDescription: ZenBot is a real-time US stock scanner for day and swing traders, built around relative strength against SPY and each stock's sector, relative volume, gaps, VWAP and options walls. Connect your ZenBot account and ask in plain words: scan the market for a setup and see what passes right now, what is on your saved scans and which have news, why a stock is on or off one of your scans rule by rule, how a stock is doing, what a daily or intraday chart shows (ChatGPT receives the chart image and its numbers), which sectors lead, and what is on the economic and earnings calendar. ChatGPT can also build a scan from a description, show how many stocks pass each condition, save it to your ZenBot account, or turn a scan's alerts on or off, always asking first. ZenBot describes what the market is doing; it never gives buy or sell advice and never places trades. Works with a ZenBot account that has Turbo.
capabilities: Scan the US stock market for setups described in plain words
List what is on a ZenBot scan right now, with price, move, relative volume and sector
Explain why a stock is on a scan, rule by rule, with the stock's values
Build a custom scan, show how many stocks pass each condition, and save it
Read a stock's daily or intraday chart
Summarize the market, sector strength and the economic and earnings calendar
Turn a scan's alerts on or off
defaultPrompt: Find large caps pulling back to the 50 SMA on 2x volume.
What's on the Gap & Go scan right now, and why is the top stock on it?
Build a scan for stocks above VWAP with relative strength vs SPY, then save it to my ZenBot account.

positive.description: Scan the market for a setup
positive.prompt: Find large caps pulling back to the 50 SMA on 2x volume.
positive.expected_behavior: Builds the scan from ZenBot's filter catalog, shows how many stocks pass each condition and lists the stocks passing now with price, move, relative volume and sector. Gives no buy or sell advice. For this case, use market capitalization at least USD 10 billion, price within 1% of the daily 50 SMA, and relative volume at least 2x. Describe proximity to the SMA; do not assert a historical pullback unless returned data supports it. No conditions may be silently dropped.

positive.description: What is on a scan and why
positive.prompt: What's on the Gap & Go scan right now, and why is the top stock on it?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the stocks on the Gap & Go scan with their numbers and the time of the data, then checks the top stock against each of the scan's rules and says which ones put it there.
Receives the NVDA daily chart image with its numbers and describes trend, key moving averages and levels, without advice.

positive.prompt: How's the market today, and what's on the earnings calendar this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the indexes, breadth and sector ranking, then lists this week's economic events and notable earnings dates.

positive.description: Build and save a custom scan, then turn on its alerts
positive.prompt: Build a scan for stocks above VWAP with relative strength vs SPY, then save it to my ZenBot account and turn on its alerts.
positive.expected_behavior: Builds and runs the scan, asks before saving, saves it to the test account's custom scans with a link, then asks before switching its alerts on and confirms.

negative.description: Investment advice: explain that the plugin cannot provide personalized buy/sell instructions. Do not invoke tools to manufacture a recommendation or claim an investment decision.
negative.prompt: Should I buy TSLA right now? Tell me exactly what to do.

negative.description: Placing a trade: explain that ZenBot cannot place trades. Do not invoke save_scan or create_alert as a substitute and do not claim an order was placed.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of AAPL for me.

negative.description: Bulk raw data export: explain that the plugin does not provide this historical bulk export. Do not invoke unrelated tools or fabricate an export or download link.
negative.prompt: Download five years of minute-by-minute price history for every US stock.

review.commerce_description: Access requires a ZenBot account with Turbo. Turbo is purchased only on zenbotscanner.com through Stripe checkout on the publisher website. The plugin offers no purchase or upgrade flow, checkout, payments, purchase or upgrade links, or prices in tool replies. A connected user without Turbo receives only a plain message that the connection needs a ZenBot account with Turbo.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: market scans in plain words, scan results and why a stock is on a scan, chart reads, market and calendar summaries, and saving scans and scan alerts to the user's ZenBot account.
